name: beam-mcp
description: Bring your Beam data into ChatGPT. Search, update, and create assets, tickets, products, and other core resources.

interface.longDescription: Bring your Beam data into ChatGPT. Search, update, and create assets, tickets, products, and other core resources.
defaultPrompt: What tags do I have in my Beam studio?
What inventory statuses are in my Beam studio?
Find inventory with product model number 'SADH44B'

positive.description: Finds inventory items by product model number
positive.prompt: What inventory does my Beam studio have with product model number 'SADH44B'?
positive.expected_behavior: Calls get_v1_inventory filtered on products.model "SADH44B" and lists the matching inventory items with details such as serial number and status, or says that none were found.

positive.description: Lists the tags available in the studio
positive.prompt: What tags do I have in my Beam studio?
positive.expected_behavior: Calls get_v1_tags and lists the studio's tags by name.

positive.description: Searches the product catalog by name or manufacturer
positive.prompt: What 'Thermodyne' products does my Beam studio have?
positive.expected_behavior: Calls get_v1_products with a search for "Thermodyne" and lists the matching products with their names and model numbers, or says that none were found.

positive.description: Counts bulk items by model number
positive.prompt: How many bulk items does my Beam studio have with the model number 'PCC-1-1-2'?
positive.expected_behavior: Calls get_v1_bulk_items filtered on model "PCC-1-1-2" and reports the matching bulk items and their quantities.

positive.description: Lists the inventory statuses configured in the studio
positive.prompt: What inventory statuses are in my Beam studio?
positive.expected_behavior: Calls get_v1_inventory_statuses and lists the available inventory statuses by name.

negative.description: Unrelated request for email access; Beam should not be used
Unrelated general-knowledge request; Beam should not be used
negative.prompt: What is the weather in Paris?

negative.description: Deletion is not supported by Beam's tools; the assistant should explain it can't delete inventory rather than call a write tool
negative.prompt: Delete an inventory item with model 'SADH44B'.
